title: Chapter 471 City Lord Kneels
content:
Chapter 471 City Lord Kneels

Seeing that there were some good-looking people in the group, he said: "Keep these women and pay a small amount of money, and forget about it."

With that said, he was about to reach out to catch Ye Xueer.

This fat man is very weak, but he is just a top military general.

But he dared to do anything in front of several intermediate generals.

Moreover, he dared to rob someone without even understanding Wang Shuo's strength. He really didn't know how to live or die.

Wang Shuo stomped his foot casually, and a leaf flew up from the ground.

Wang Shuo waved his hand, and the leaves were lifted up by the strong energy and slashed towards the arm of the city lord's son.

In an instant, a bloody arm fell to the ground.

"Ah, my hands."

The fat man fell to the ground wailing, screaming in pain.

The few masters he brought with him were even more upset when they saw this. The son of the city lord had his arm cut off.

As bodyguards, this is a very serious matter.

Wang Shuo looked at the people rushing up and had no intention of fighting with these servants.

He turned to look at the princes' subordinates and said, "If you can defeat these people and let me see your abilities, maybe I can give you a chance to change your destiny."

These masters naturally knew Wang Shuo's identity and strength, so they immediately stopped keeping a low profile and started fighting with the bodyguards on the opposite side.

After a while, a giant dragon rushed over the city carrying the city lord.

"Who dared to hit my son without opening his eyes?"

Wang Shuo noticed that this giant dragon was a star-level boss.

If he didn't take action, he might not be able to defeat him.

The green pterosaur hovered in the sky, putting huge pressure on everyone.

A dive.

The Sifang City Lord came to the teleportation array and felt Wang Shuo's aura.

Suddenly the soul was frightened.

Seeing the scene in front of him, he already understood what happened.

"Dad, it was him who cut off my arm. Dad, kill him, kill him!"

The fat man wailed and cried to his father.

The Sifang City Lord was so frightened by his son's words that chills ran down his back.

This is driving your father to death!

This is such a scam!

"You are the Lord of Sifang City, right?" Wang Shuo's tone was a bit unkind, with a trace of murderous intent in his eyes.

The Lord of Sifang City swung and knelt on the ground.

The murderous aura released from Wang Shuo's body was something that Sifang City Lord was lucky enough to experience once from a distance when he was young and from a king-level general.

This is definitely the king who emerged from the mountain of corpses and sea of blood.

Although Sifang City Lord also has the strength of a high-level warrior, his ability to survive to this day is definitely not because of his strength, but because he can assess the situation and know when to give in and when to be tough.

"The little one is."

The Lord of Sifang City knelt down.

The jaws of everyone around him dropped.

Especially the dudes, they knew that Wang Shuo was very strong, but one sentence that made a high-ranking warrior city lord kneel down still shocked them deeply.

Wang Shuo has no interest in this kind of city lord.

He just said lightly: "Take care of your son."

"Also, can we go?"

"Of course."

He turned to the group of bodyguards behind him and said, "Don't give way yet."

Wang Shuo took Ye Xueer's hand and walked into the teleportation array first.

He didn't dare to get up until Wang Shuo and others left.

What the hell, I didn’t look at the almanac when I went out today!

Then he exploded with momentum and killed everyone present except his son.

These people must die, who let them see themselves kneeling.
